messages:
laura: Quick FYI — I noticed the README in examples/quickstart has two problems that will trip up new users: the auth snippet uses the legacy API key env var name and the code example still calls `client.createCompletion()` (old SDK). Also no mention of our recommended retry/backoff wrapper, so folks copy/paste and hit flaky failures.

max: Can you paste the exact lines? I can open a tiny PR.

laura: Sure — current README has:
```js
const client = new RedwoodClient(process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY);
const res = await client.createCompletion({ model: 'redwood-1.0', prompt: 'hi' });
```
Should be:
```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY }); // env var name change
const res = await client.text.generate({ model: 'redwood-1.0', input: 'hi' });
```
And we recommend wrapping calls with `withRetries()` in devx utils.

asya: Good catch. We've had a couple of support tickets about this. I think two steps: update the README snippet, and add a short note under "Troubleshooting" about transient 429/503 + our retry helper.

docs-bot: checklist: [ ] update example snippet in examples/quickstart/README.md [ ] add retry note + code sample [ ] bump sample app deps if needed [ ] run snippet tests (snippet-runner).

tom: I'll take the snippet change. Will also run snippet-runner locally. FYI, older sample apps still pin `@redwood/sdk@0.x` and rely on `createCompletion` — maybe we should add a short compatibility blurb or a tiny shim in examples?

laura: A shim is OK but prefer to make the canonical example reflect current SDK. If we add a shim it should be in legacy/ directory with comment.

jen: Also, the README currently shows `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...` in the auth section. We standardized on `REDWOOD_KEY` last quarter. Update that and add a one-liner about using `REDWOOD_KEY` in CI/CD and the Token TTL caveat.

max: PR up in draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/examples/pull/452 — updates snippet, adds retry example, and modifies env var name. I included a fenced retry helper example: 
```js
import { withRetries } from '@redwood/devx';
const safeGen = withRetries((input) => client.text.generate({ model: 'redwood-1.0', input }));
const out = await safeGen('hello');
```

asya: Nice. Can you also add a tiny note to changelog.md: "Quickstart: updated to new SDK v1 APIs and env var names" so users searching history won't be confused.

tom: I ran snippet-runner; one failing test left — sample-app uses an async import pattern that changed in node v18. I'm fixing that in a follow-up commit.

jen: small nit — update the code fence language to `js` on all snippets and run prettier/formatting action to avoid CI failure.

laura: Thanks everyone. Once tom's node fix lands, can someone merge the PR and bump the examples tag? I want this fixed before next week's onboarding session — new hires hit this. :pray:

max: will merge after CI green and tom's commit.

docs-bot: automation note: will create an issue to run a repo-wide grep for `createCompletion\(|REDWOOD_API_KEY` and open PR suggestions if found.

laura: Awesome — closing the loop. After merge I'll update the onboarding checklist to point to the revised example.
